decision: adopt source geometry allocation reduction and ordered selection streaming

changes: Merge adjacent raw source clusters in place instead of allocating a second full cluster vector.
Yield paint segment tuples as an iterator instead of collecting a duplicate vector.
Stream horizontal merges for source-ordered segments already sorted by the original merge key; compact both fallback merge passes in place.
Cache eligibility per immutable line index; retain original two-sort fallback for bidi/unordered geometry.

measurement.allocation: 3 independent process samples per side and condition, one operation per sample; allocator result captured before JSON construction. Preparation and hashes excluded; output drop included. All calls/bytes/net/peak samples identical per condition.
measurement.timing: Separate normal-allocator executables, pinned to logical CPU 10. Six ABBA blocks, 12 process samples per side and condition; 8 warmups before measured iterations. Scope elapsed captured before JSON construction; fixture loading, preparation and validation hashes excluded. Output drop included; build includes input insertion. No concurrent task-owned builds/tests/profiles during elapsed measurement.
measurement.build_isolation: Baseline and candidate use distinct CARGO_TARGET_DIR directories. A trial with a shared target reused the candidate executable for baseline; identical binary hashes and counters exposed this, and those comparison results were discarded. Final pair has distinct hashes and baseline/candidate regression allocation counts.
limitations: Shared desktop CPU is not isolated from external load; ratios describe these scopes and workloads only.
Gross allocated bytes are temporary allocator traffic, not process RSS or universal retained-memory savings.
Long contiguous selection output remains one rectangle; sparse/bidi output size and sort complexity still depend on geometry.
Existing paint probe retains results at scope end while source_geometry includes result drop; compare only matching scopes.
Memcheck could not start because ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 lacks the mandatory memcmp symbol; no memory-safety claim derives from it.

The eligibility boolean adds 8 retained bytes per line on this build. latin-long hit index net/peak increase by 1152 bytes (144 lines), while gross allocation traffic decreases. Paint net/peak are unchanged because returned spans dominate.

rejected_experiment.reason: Existing japanese-long scale8 has little reuse within each run; allocations and instructions increased. Repeated single-run punctuation regression proved reuse but did not establish benefit for this corpus. Cache and related test instrumentation were removed.

regression_evidence.selection_allocation_red: Original code: 1024-character full selection 13 calls / 49280 bytes, exceeding 512-byte bound. Final passes 1024/4096/16384 chars, short/full selections, forward/reversed endpoints, with independent caret-based rectangle expectation.
regression_evidence.source_geometry_allocation_red: Original code: 1024-character paint 41 calls / 818412 bytes, exceeding 716800-byte bound. Final paint and hit allocation guards pass at 1024/4096 characters.
regression_evidence.ruby_guard: Eight line-layout constructions improve from 47 to 40 allocations each; tighten call cap to <=320 and byte cap to <1650000 (observed 1621248).
regression_evidence.semantic_coverage: Existing exhaustive selection oracle and GDEF/grapheme/bidi/TCY/ruby/vertical cases, plus unchanged fixed glyph snapshots. Independent static review reported no critical/important findings.
regression_evidence.normal_workspace_note: Normal workspace run during implementation included one subsequently removed punctuation experiment test; final accesskit/no-default/complex-only runs use the final engine source.

reproduction: Create separate baseline (65ae1a0453f3a6594ceff4887152e5fbf201afcb) and candidate checkouts. Copy the candidate source_geometry example into baseline so both use exactly the same harness.

In each checkout, use a distinct CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$perf_dir/$version-target" and CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_RUNNER=/usr/bin/env. Run cargo build --offline --locked --release -p shodo-bench --example source_geometry --example paint_geometry --features allocation-counting, then copy both executables to "$perf_dir/$version-$example-alloc". Rebuild without allocation-counting and copy timing executables separately.

Run source_geometry OPERATION CASE SCALE ITERATIONS using the conditions and iteration counts in results; allocations use ITERATIONS=1 and 3 samples, timing uses taskset -c 10 and ABBA repeated six times. Verify geometry/paint/selection hashes match in every result.
Run SHODO_GEOMETRY_SAMPLES=3 "$perf_dir/$version-paint_geometry-alloc"; compare all fields except measure for the 96 rows.

Run hyperfine --warmup 3 --runs 10 --export-json "$perf_dir/hyperfine.json" "taskset -c 10 $perf_dir/baseline-source_geometry-time selection plain 16384 2000" "taskset -c 10 $perf_dir/final-source_geometry-time selection plain 16384 2000".
After preserving conditions/results, remove only the temporary files and disposable worktrees created for this reproduction.
